text: The resonance principle governs coupled oscillators and harmonic synchronization across physical systems. Resonance energy transfer links damped harmonic motion to entrainment.
Harmonic synchronization and resonance energy transfer recur wherever coupled oscillators entrain. Damped harmonic motion is the canonical example.
Resonance principle reappears in entrainment, synchronization, and coupled oscillator theory alike. The transfer of resonance energy underlies each case.
Photosynthesis converts light into chemical energy through chlorophyll and the Calvin cycle. Carbon fixation is the rate-limiting step.
Chlorophyll captures photons and drives carbon fixation via the Calvin cycle in photosynthesis. Light energy is stored as chemical energy.
The Doppler effect shifts observed frequency when a source moves relative to an observer. Redshift and blueshift are the audio analogues.
A moving source produces frequency shifts in the Doppler effect; approaching sources blueshift and receding sources redshift.
Entropy tends to increase in isolated systems per the second law of thermodynamics. Irreversibility and heat death follow from entropy growth.
Quantum entanglement links particle states non-locally. Measurement of one correlated pair instantaneously constrains the other.
A deliberate contradiction test: the entropy of an isolated system always decreases over time.
